page_transition_fade.css: @keyframes pageFade { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .page-enter { animation: pageFade 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) both; }

hover_image_reveal.css: .work-item { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .work-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #000; transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .work-item:hover::after { transform: translateY(0); } .work-item .reveal-title { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s 0.2s; z-index: 2; position: relative; color: #FFE500; } .work-item:hover .reveal-title { opacity: 1; }

text_scramble_effect.css: @keyframes scramble { 0%,100% { letter-spacing: 0; } 25% { letter-spacing: 0.05em; transform: skewX(-2deg); } 50% { letter-spacing: -0.02em; } 75% { letter-spacing: 0.03em; transform: skewX(1deg); } } .scramble:hover { animation: scramble 0.4s steps(4) both; }

horizontal_marquee.css: @keyframes marquee { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } } .marquee-track { display: inline-flex; white-space: nowrap; animation: marquee 30s linear infinite; }

cursor_dot.css: .cursor-dot { position: fixed; width: 24px; height: 24px; background: #FFE500; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: difference; transition: transform 0.15s ease; z-index: 9999; }

home.layout: Full-bleed black hero with 200px white agency name, manifesto line beneath, three overlapping case study previews with monospace numerical labels colliding diagonally down the page.

work.layout: Asymmetric brutalist grid of case studies in mixed sizes, some full-bleed bleeding past edges, project names overlapping images in oversized serif type.

case_study.layout: Massive brand name header, full-bleed hero image, large-scale project brief, irregular process photo collage, oversized metrics, yellow accent blocks.

studio.layout: Manifesto-style large text statements stacked, asymmetric team photo grid with overlaid names, compact client logo wall, infinite awards marquee at bottom.

contact.layout: Sparse page with single 80px email address centered, small address text, minimal underlined form fields, plain text social links bottom-left.
